origin.author: jmeter-rs project
origin.description: Hand-authored static FX-FUZZ-001 index for the repository's ten bounded fuzz targets, 29 source-declared invariant IDs, 34-seed synthetic corpus, and campaign contract files. It records source paths and SHA-256 values without copying fuzz inputs or target code.

license.repository_notice: LICENSE and NOTICE at repository root
license.upstream_distribution_use: Apache JMeter 5.6.3 is a pinned profile reference only; no JMeter distribution, plan, result, plugin, or binary is redistributed by this static fuzz manifest.

oracle.verification_basis: Copied from the active profile's pinned artifact metadata; no JMeter or Java process was run for this manifest.

runtime.target_triple: not measured; target source and corpus paths are platform-independent
runtime.os_image: not measured; no campaign was run
runtime.hostname_policy: not asserted; fuzz targets must not use hostnames
runtime.jmeter_classpath: not executed; fuzz targets must not load Java or plugins

source_references.index: case.json.source_references is the complete path/hash inventory for the current fuzz workspace, ten target sources, 29 source-declared invariant IDs, 34 corpus seeds, campaign contract files, fixture schema/example/negative vectors, and provenance documents.

target_contract.role: canonical target names, input bounds, seed directories, and static validation policy; the local fixture additionally indexes the current Cargo target expansion

corpus_provenance.role: original synthetic seed provenance and per-seed purpose/bounds; absent new-target directories are recorded as zero-seed by design

evidence.future_evidence: case.json.future_campaign and expected/campaign-evidence.schema.json declare the bounded run record, per-target counts, invariant results, and crash/hang/minimization artifact schema required before review.
